title: fq-segment/1 — segment file metadata
description: The __metadata__ block of a Progressive Tensors segment file (layer-LLL.kK.safetensors). The segment itself is an ordinary safetensors file: its payload holds the routed-expert tensors of ONE MoE layer at ONE K, in canonical order (expert id, then projection, rank, component), so every expert's bytes are contiguous and range-readable. safetensors requires all __metadata__ values to be strings; numbers below are therefore decimal strings. Derived from files emitted by fq_repack, fq_prime and fq_fetch (real examples: ~/fq-segments/GLM-5.2-EXL3-FQ, ~/fq-0c/fruit-segments, ~/fq-primed/segments-336).

predicate.description: How these bytes came to be. repack-of: copied verbatim out of a published checkpoint. derived-from: computed from other segments by a declared, exact rule. encode-of: produced by running a quantizer on pinned inputs.

k.description: trellis bit-width of every expert in this file; absent for shared-profile files

layout.description: rotation/tensor layout of the source checkpoint

num_experts.description: how many experts this file carries (a subset file carries fewer than the model has)

source_file.description: shard the bytes were taken from

fq_fetch.description: set by fq_fetch: this file holds only the experts a recipe asked for

fq_fetch_sources.description: comma-separated repo@revision list the subset was assembled from
